clips.title: The story
paras: Ayessa Dawnsinger is a Skyborne leader found in Valanaar on Zephras Isle. She leads the Windshapers, guiding the Skyborne aligned with the Horde through their trials and politics.

Standing within the settlement of Valanaar on Zephras Isle, Ayessa Dawnsinger serves as the paramount guide for the Windshapers—the faction of Skyborne aligned with the Horde. From this vantage, she directs critical efforts across the island, managing external threats, internal fractures, and the overarching survival of her people as they navigate alliances in Kalimdor and beyond.
